# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report sensitive security issues via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:
https://github.com/mohdarsh79/agentshield-ultimate/security/advisories/new

- **Response time**: Acknowledgement within 24 hours.
- **Triage**: Rapid patch within 72 hours for critical findings.
